name: amfx-preelection-seasonal-ndx-research
description: amFX reproduction (27SEP23 p1): NASDAQ average seasonal return path during pre-election years (1999-2023). Shows consistent pattern of bottoming in early October then rallying hard into year-end. Pre-election years: year % 4 == 3. Source: Brent Donnelly, Spectra Markets.
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: PRE-ELECTION YEAR SEASONAL — NASDAQ (27SEP23 p1)
# =============================================================================
# Average calendar-year return path across pre-election years (year%4==3).
# Pre-election years since 1998: 1999, 2003, 2007, 2011, 2015, 2019, 2023.
# Pattern: trough in early October, then rally into year-end.
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

year_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(index())
day_of_year = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.day_of_year)(index())

# Year-open price via forward fill
is_yr1 = year_num != (year_num >> 1)
yr_open = ffill(close if is_yr1 else 0.0 / 0.0)
ytd = (close / yr_open - 1) * 100

# Pre-election year filter: year % 4 == 3
is_pre_election = (year_num % 4) == 3

# Current year (2023) shown separately
is_2023 = year_num == 2023
is_hist = is_pre_election and not is_2023

hist_ytd = where(is_hist, ytd)
curr_ytd = where(is_2023, ytd)

# =============================================================================
# CHART: NASDAQ Pre-Election Year Average Seasonal Path
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='NASDAQ: Pre-Election Year Seasonal Path (Avg 1999-2019)',
    category='Pre-Election Seasonality',
    y_axis_label='Cumulative Return (%)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.DayOfYear,
    smooth=True,
    data_labels=False,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='2023 Path', color=Color.Blue, agg=AggregationType.Last),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Avg Pre-Election Year (1999-2019)', color=Color.Gray, agg=AggregationType.Mean)
    ]),
    order=0
)(day_of_year, curr_ytd, hist_ytd)
